task_title: Deterministic reward-opening UX (achievement boxes + boss chests)

plan_review.notes: Adversarial rubber-duck review (gpt-5.4, high reasoning) of the shared reward-opening-sequence design. Verdict REJECT with 3 blocking + 3 non-blocking findings. Alt A: persisted presentation-ticket queue for save/load resume -- adopted in spirit (pendingPresentations map on world.achievements + revealedGrant on boss chest state). Alt B: provenance/claim-history reconstruction for resume -- rejected as too broad/over-engineered vs the ticket-queue approach. Alt C: auto-open scene overlay for boss chests instead of inventing new chest-interaction semantics -- adopted (BossChestUI drives RewardOpeningUI via the same shared renderer as AchievementsUI). Blocking issues fixed: (1) achievement save/load-resume gap -- added pendingPresentations persistence + fail-closed playerCarryover restore; (2) boss chest real-game integration underspecified -- resolved via Alt C; (3) carryover restore not fail-closed enough -- reworked to fail closed on any resolution error. divergence=minor: alternatives refined save/load + boss-chest integration details, but the core single shared reward-opening-sequence architecture was not re-architected.
